title: Build shared customer report configuration workspace
description: Create independent report-configuration workspace in existing ERP navigation/router. One shared page lets customer list private definitions, create from authorized dataset catalog, choose/reorder fields, configure provider-supported typed filters/grouping, preview and save/copy/rename/delete, inspect revisions and publish/restore pinned definitions. Use server capabilities to hide unsupported custom formulas/pivot/joins/sharing/export until later Stage1 increments; show why unsupported instead of decorative controls. Distinguish draft versus published revision and current page versus grouped coverage; separate currencies/units. Preserve unsaved local edits until save succeeds, detect stale-version conflict without overwriting, escape all user/catalog strings, discard late preview responses after dataset/config changes and clear stale rows on authorization/failure. Use existing app.js for route dispatch/navigation and index.html only for new script inclusion, authorized dataset availability controls page, API remains authoritative. Keep old report menus/URLs unchanged until all Stage2 migrations verified. No new SeedData/menu database writes: reuse current dataset menu authorization for initial workspace access; new dedicated administrator sharing permission is future platform increment. Report configuration DB absence explicitly displayed as environment blocked, no browser-local storage substituted for persisted definitions. Tests of UI source contracts plus relevant controller/in-memory integration; no screenshot-only/browser claims. Stage 1 of user-directed sequence: finish reusable report configuration platform before any existing-report migration, cross-business flow development or embedded Agent task. No new dedicated business report controller/DTO/designer/exporter. Existing sales-order and receivable datasets are two adapter fixtures proving one shared contract, not report-by-report migration; keep existing endpoints/pages unchanged. Reuse server-authenticated user ID, dataset-specific existing menu authorization and fresh customer data scope; permissions are rechecked on catalog/save/load/preview, saved configurations never grant permission. Finite metadata fields/filters/grouping/operators only, no arbitrary SQL, C# scripts, user-selected tables or joins, client identity/scope/data as authority, mixed currencies/units or duplicate order-header totals from one-to-many joins. Fail unsupported capabilities explicitly rather than pretending they run. Preserve unrelated and current executor work. Code, EF mapping and in-memory/offline relational model tests allowed, but no migration, SchemaUpgrader/SeedData modification, production SQL/DB execution, schema/view/stored-procedure mutation, secrets/.env/config changes, production deployment, irreversible operations or real browser-only acceptance. Run meaningful unit/service/API and relevant offline integration tests and configured safe build/test. New metadata tables require later approved database provisioning: absence is an explicit environment blocker for real persistence acceptance, never silently use an in-memory runtime fallback or claim phase complete from build alone. Existing HTTP audit and BaseEntity audit conventions; no ERP business records altered.
acceptance_criteria: Independent shared workspace route/navigation and authorized catalog drive dataset/field reorder/filter/group/preview without duplicating business report pages or exposing unsupported controls.
Definition save/copy/rename/delete and revision publish/restore distinguish drafts and handle unsaved/stale/permission/environment errors while escaping strings and dropping late preview responses.

UI/API contract tests cover changed datasets/fields, out-of-order response protection, revoked access, concurrency conflicts and empty/error state; old entry points remain usable and safe build/test passes.
